2463-3259-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2463-3259-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

855-5254-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
855-5254-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

586-864-3125-3899-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-3899-7396.description:
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

728-1981-2415-6720.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-6720.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

907-2034-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

341-4067-5078-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Umori.
Repeat

427-4091-7791.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn two or more cards this turn.
427-4091-7791.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Kydele.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Kydele.
Repeat.

997-4276-5088-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
997-4276-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
997-4276-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Turnabout with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Turnabout.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

1445-2921-4871-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2921-4871-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

215-3464-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Forests.
215-3464-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Rofellos.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4050-4976-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4050-4976-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Open the Graves and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2279-2292-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-4359-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-4359-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

1115-2011-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-2011-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1115-2011-3259.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

339-677-5295-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-5295-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

1409-2097-3128.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve the Skullport Merchant trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3585-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3263-6871-7033.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Bumi triggers, untapping all lands you control, including Bumi as it's a land due to Toph, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1850-4426-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4426-5414.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1174-1479-3875.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1174-1479-3875.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

1766-2225-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
1766-2225-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Thran Dynamo's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2438-3391-4871-6019.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

313-1500-2236.notablePrerequisites: Witch Engine does not have summoning sickness.
313-1500-2236.description:
Activate Witch Engine by tapping it.
Holding priority, cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {2}{B} due to Blood Funnel.
Blood Funnel triggers, causing you to sacrifice Witch Engine.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Witch Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield, giving it haste, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Resolve the Witch Engine ability from step 1, adding {B}{B}{B}{B} and failing to give an opponent control of Witch Engine as it is a new object.
Repeat.

2567-4050-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
2567-4050-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Avenger of Zendikar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing Avenger of Zendikar and four Plants, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.
If you control five or more lands, this combo nets infinite creature tokens and colored mana, which can be used to activate any of Kenrtih's other abilities.

659-3750-4050.easyPrerequisites: Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
659-3750-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Goblins.
659-3750-4050.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least five 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Goblin tokens, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

3062-5115-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Gemstone Array.
3062-5115-5149.description:
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {1}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

856-3765-5049.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the Voldran Epicure trigger from step 2, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1651-2561-4772-4798.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, creating two Food tokens.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Ovalchase Daredevil twice, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Repeat.

3750-4050-4373.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least six creatures that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
3750-4050-4373.description:
Declare at least six creatures you control as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating at least six 1/1 Vampire creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Vampires, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

855-1002-3352-4050.description:
Cast Hooded Hydra by paying {7}{G}{G}, causing it to enter the battlefield with fourteen +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hooded Hydra, adding {B}.
Hooded Hydra dies, creating fourteen 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar thirteen times by sacrificing thirteen Snakes, adding {11}{G}{G}.
Cast Disturbed Burial with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Hooded Hydra from your graveyard to your hand, and returning Disturbed Burial to your hand.
Repeat.

351-1339-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Dagger attached to The Locust God.
The Locust God does not have summoning sickness.
351-1339-1636.description:
Activate The Locust God using the Quicksilver Dagger ability by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target player and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

951-1940-4871-5220.description:
Cast Shivan Devastator by paying {R}.
Shivan Devastator enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary, Pitiless Plunderer and Liliana trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shivan Devastator on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, causing you to draw Shivan Devastator.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

654-1257-3147-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Walking Atlas.
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
654-1257-3147-3525.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

1409-2819-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Goblin Goliath.
1409-2819-4050.description:
Activate Goblin Goliath by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Goblin Goliath enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Goblin Goliath.
Resolve the Goblin Goliath trigger, creating at least three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Goblin tokens, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

803-1385-2034-2721-5170.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodline Necromancer, adding {C}{C}.
Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji, adding {C}{C}.
Zulaport Cutthroat and Junji trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, causing you to lose 2 life and to put Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, causing you to return Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1987-2427-2493-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
